blocks.text: Karibu! Kiingereza kina herufi 26. Habari njema: unazijua tayari, kwa sababu Kiswahili kinatumia herufi zilezile. Habari ngumu kidogo: katika Kiingereza, herufi moja inaweza kuwa na sauti nyingi.
Katika Kiswahili, vokali tano (a, e, i, o, u) hutamkwa vilevile kila mara. Katika Kiingereza, vokali hubadilika kulingana na neno. Hii ndiyo sababu Kiingereza kinaonekana kigumu mwanzoni.

lines: Hutahitaji kukariri kanuni zote leo. Sikiliza maneno, rudia kwa sauti, na masikio yako yatajifunza yenyewe. Pole pole ndiyo mwendo.
th - kama 'think' na 'this'. Weka ulimi kati ya meno.
r - Kiingereza cha Marekani hakikunji ulimi kama Kiswahili.
v na w - 'very' na 'well' ni tofauti kabisa.

blocks.intro: Gusa kipaza sauti kisha useme neno. Tutakagua ulichosema.

blocks.text: Katika Kiingereza, salamu hutegemea wakati wa siku na jinsi unavyomjua mtu. Kuna salamu za heshima na za kirafiki.

lines: "Hi" ni ya kirafiki zaidi kuliko "Hello". Kwa mtu mkubwa au bosi, tumia "Good morning" au "Hello".
"Good night" si salamu ya kukutana - ni ya kuagana unapokwenda kulala.

a book, a house, a university (inasikika 'yunivesiti')

blocks.text: Kiswahili hubadilisha MWANZO wa neno: mtu kuwa watu, kitabu kuwa vitabu. Kiingereza hubadilisha MWISHO: book kuwa books. Hii ni rahisi zaidi, lakini kuna maneno ya kipekee.

blocks.intro: Gusa nomino uone jinsi wingi wake unavyoundwa. Sehemu ya dhahabu ndiyo inayobadilika.

foot kuwa feet, tooth kuwa teeth, person kuwa people
Haya hayafuati kanuni yoyote. Yakaririwe.

title: Viwakilishi
subtitle: I, you, he, she, it, we, they

blocks.text: Katika Kiswahili, mtendaji huonyeshwa kwa kiambishi ndani ya kitenzi: NInasoma, TUnasoma. Katika Kiingereza, mtendaji ni neno lake mwenyewe linalosimama peke yake: I read, we read.

lines: Kiswahili kina 'yeye' moja kwa mwanamume na mwanamke. Kiingereza kina MAWILI: he (mwanamume) na she (mwanamke).
Kwa vitu na wanyama, Kiingereza hutumia 'it'.
Kiingereza kina 'you' moja kwa umoja na wingi - rahisi!
Juma ni mwanamume. Yeye ni mwalimu. kuwa He is a teacher.
Asha ni mwanamke. Yeye ni daktari. kuwa She is a doctor.
Kitabu ni kizuri. kuwa It is good.

blocks.text: Katika Kiswahili, neno 'ni' halibadiliki: mimi ni, wewe ni, yeye ni. Katika Kiingereza, kitenzi hiki kina maumbo MATATU, na lazima uchague sahihi.

blocks.intro: Gusa mtendaji uone umbo sahihi la kitenzi 'to be'.

lines: Katika mazungumzo, Waingereza hufupisha:
I am kuwa I'm, you are kuwa you're, she is kuwa she's
we are kuwa we're, they are kuwa they're

blocks.intro: Rudia sentensi hizi.

blocks.text: Hongera! Umemaliza wiki ya kwanza. Umejifunza salamu, kujitambulisha, a/an/the, wingi, viwakilishi, na kitenzi 'to be'. Sasa tuviunganishe.

lines: Kiingereza kinahitaji a/an/the - Kiswahili hakina.
Wingi huongezwa mwishoni (-s), si mwanzoni.
Kuna he na she - si 'yeye' moja.
Kitenzi 'to be' kina maumbo matatu: am, is, are.

blocks.intro: Panga maneno kwa mpangilio sahihi, kisha bofya Check.

lines: Usijali kama bado unasahau 'a' na 'the'. Hata wanafunzi wa muda mrefu husahau. Endelea kusikiliza na kusoma - masikio yako yatajifunza.

quiz.prompt: Tafsiri kwa Kiingereza: Sisi ni wanafunzi.

blocks.text: Katika Kiswahili, kitenzi hubeba kiambishi cha mtendaji: NInasoma, TUnasoma. Katika Kiingereza, kitenzi HAKIBADILIKI hata kidogo - isipokuwa kwa he, she, it, ambapo huongeza -s.

blocks.intro: Gusa mtendaji na kitenzi. Angalia kinachotokea unapochagua He / She.

lines: Nyingi: ongeza -s tu (work kuwa works)
Inaishia -o, -ch, -sh, -s, -x: ongeza -es (go kuwa goes, watch kuwa watches)
Konsonanti + y: badilisha kuwa -ies (study kuwa studies)
Wanafunzi husahau -s kwa he/she/it. "She work here" si sahihi. Ni "She workS here".
Hii ni kanuni inayosahaulika zaidi katika Kiingereza chote.

blocks.text: Katika Kiswahili tunakanusha kwa kubadilisha kiambishi: ninasoma kuwa SIsomi. Katika Kiingereza tunaongeza neno la msaada: don't au doesn't.

blocks.intro: Gusa mtendaji na kitenzi uone neno sahihi la kukanusha.

lines: Baada ya doesn't, kitenzi HAKICHUKUI -s!
Sahihi: She doesn't work.
Si sahihi: She doesn't works.
Sababu: 'doesn't' tayari imebeba -s ndani yake (does).

quiz.prompt: Kwa nini hatutumii -s baada ya doesn't?

title: Maswali
subtitle: Do, Does na maneno ya kuuliza

blocks.text: Katika Kiswahili, swali linaweza kuwa sawa na kauli - sauti tu ndiyo hubadilika: Unasoma? Katika Kiingereza, lazima uanze na neno la msaada: Do au Does.

lines: Baada ya Does, kitenzi HAKICHUKUI -s. "Does she works?" si sahihi.
Ni "Does she work?" - kwa sababu 'does' imebeba -s.

blocks.text: Kiingereza kina njia mbili za kuzungumzia sasa. 'I work' ni kwa mazoea (kila siku). 'I am working' ni kwa kinachotokea SASA HIVI. Kiswahili hutumia 'ninafanya kazi' kwa hali zote mbili.

lines: am / is / are + kitenzi + ing
I am eating. You are eating. She is eating.
Kumbuka: unahitaji SEHEMU MBILI - 'to be' na '-ing'.
Vitenzi vinavyoishia -e: hondoa e (write kuwa writing)
Konsonanti moja mwishoni: irudie (sit kuwa sitting, run kuwa running)
Vingine: ongeza -ing tu (work kuwa working)

blocks.text: Hii ni tofauti kubwa. Katika Kiswahili, kivumishi HUFUATA nomino: nyumba KUBWA. Katika Kiingereza, kivumishi HUTANGULIA nomino: a BIG house.

a big house, big houses, the big man, big women

blocks.text: Wiki hii umejifunza wakati uliopo, kukanusha, maswali, wakati unaoendelea, vivumishi, namba na siku. Tuunganishe yote.

lines: He / she / it huongeza -s: She works.
Kukanusha: don't / doesn't - na kitenzi hakichukui -s.

blocks.text: Katika Kiswahili, wakati uliopita huonyeshwa kwa kiambishi -li-: niLIsoma. Katika Kiingereza, huongezwa -ed mwishoni mwa kitenzi - na hakibadiliki kwa mtendaji yeyote!

title: Vitenzi vya Kipekee
subtitle: go kuwa went, eat kuwa ate

blocks.text: Kiingereza kina vitenzi takriban 180 visivyofuata kanuni ya -ed. Habari njema: vinavyotumika sana ni takriban 50 tu, na utavijua kwa kuvisikia mara kwa mara.

blocks.intro: Gusa kitenzi uone umbo lake la wakati uliopita.

lines: I / he / she / it kuwa WAS
You / we / they kuwa WERE

blocks.text: Kwa maswali na kukanusha katika wakati uliopita, tumia DID. Na kama ilivyo kwa 'does', kitenzi hurudi kwenye umbo lake la msingi.

lines: Baada ya did / didn't, kitenzi HAKICHUKUI umbo la wakati uliopita!
Sahihi: Did you go? / I didn't go.
Si sahihi: Did you went? / I didn't went.
Sababu: 'did' tayari inaonyesha wakati uliopita.

blocks.text: Katika Kiswahili, wakati ujao ni kiambishi -ta-: niTAsoma. Katika Kiingereza, ni neno moja tu: WILL. Na ni rahisi sana - halibadiliki kamwe.

blocks.intro: Gusa mtendaji na kitenzi. 'will' haibadiliki kamwe, na kitenzi hubaki kama kilivyo.

lines: I will kuwa I'll, she will kuwa she'll, they will kuwa they'll
Kukanusha: will not kuwa won't
Mfano: I won't go. (Sitaenda.)

blocks.text: Kuna njia nyingine ya wakati ujao: 'going to'. Hutumika kwa mipango uliyopanga tayari, au unapoona dalili.

tableRows: I am going to visit my mother.
Look! It is going to rain.

lines: am / is / are + going to + kitenzi
I am going to travel. She is going to study.
Kumbuka: unahitaji 'to be' kwanza!

blocks.intro: Rudia sentensi za mipango.

quiz.prompt: Jaza pengo: I am ___ to travel next week.

blocks.text: 'Can' huonyesha uwezo - unachoweza kufanya. Katika Kiswahili ni 'naweza'. Baada ya can, kitenzi hubaki kama kilivyo.

lines: can + kitenzi cha msingi. Hakuna 'to', hakuna -s, hakuna -ing.
Sahihi: She can swim.
Si sahihi: She can to swim. / She cans swim. / She can swims.
Katika duka au ofisi, 'Could' ni ya heshima zaidi kuliko 'Can'.
Could you help me, please? ni nzuri zaidi kuliko Can you help me?

blocks.text: Kwa kumiliki, Kiingereza hutumia 'have'. Kama ilivyo kwa vitenzi vingine, he/she/it hutumia umbo tofauti: HAS.

lines: Swali: Do you have a car? / Does she have a car?
Kukanusha: I don't have a car. / She doesn't have a car.
Angalia: baada ya does/doesn't tunatumia HAVE, si has!

blocks.text: Umbo hili huonyesha kitu kilichotokea lakini bado kina uhusiano na sasa. Kiswahili hutumia -me-: niMEkula. Kiingereza hutumia have/has + umbo la tatu la kitenzi.

lines: Vitenzi vya kawaida: sawa na wakati uliopita (worked, finished)
Vya kipekee: umbo la tatu (go kuwa went kuwa GONE, eat kuwa ate kuwa EATEN, see kuwa saw kuwa SEEN)
Kariri: go-went-gone, eat-ate-eaten, see-saw-seen, do-did-done
I ate rice. - wakati fulani uliopita (jana)
I have eaten. - hivi punde, bado nimeshiba sasa
Tumia 'have/has' unapozungumzia matokeo ya sasa.
